description: This file implements the DobbyInterface class, which manages container lifecycle operations and event handling for containers using Dobby proxy. It includes methods to start, stop, pause, resume, hibernate, wakeup, execute commands, and manage annotations and mounts on containers, along with event notification mechanisms for container state changes.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: Class responsible for managing container lifecycle via Dobby proxy, handling events, and managing container operations in a WPEFramework plugin environment.
